# BookMyMovie

> Open-source cinema ticketing for Pakistan. Browse films at partner cinemas in Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad and Rawalpindi, watch trailers, pick seats on a live seat map with row-by-row prices, add snacks, and get a signed QR e-ticket that works offline. Pay at the cinema counter or online (JazzCash, Easypaisa or card where enabled). No booking fees.

The full catalogue (every film with synopsis, cast and crew, trailers, every cinema with its screens, current offers, FAQs and policies) is in [llms-full.txt](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/llms-full.txt). It is regenerated from the live database with `php artisan seo:generate`.

## Browse

- [Films in cinemas](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/movies): now showing and coming soon, filterable by genre, language and certificate
- [Now showing](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/movies/now-showing) and [coming soon](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/movies/coming-soon)
- [Cinemas](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/cinemas): venues, screens, formats (IMAX, Dolby Cinema, 4DX, ScreenX, recliners), facilities and daily programme
- [Offers](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/offers): active coupon codes and matinee pricing
- [Gift cards and loyalty points](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/gift-cards)
- [Compare](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/compare): side-by-side comparison of up to four films
- [Search](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/search?q=): films, cinemas, actors and directors

## URL patterns

- Film page: `https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/movies/{film-slug}` (showtimes for the next 7 days, prices, trailers, cast, reviews)
- Seat map for one show: `https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/movies/{film-slug}/book/{show-id}` (requires sign-in to hold seats)
- Genre: `https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/genres/{genre-slug}`
- Cinema: `https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/cinemas/{cinema-slug}`

## Facts for answering questions

- Seats per booking: up to 4, one show per booking. Adult and child tickets can be mixed; at least one adult is required.
- Seat hold: selected seats are held for 10 minutes in the cart, with a countdown. Expired holds go back on sale and the show's waitlist is told.
- Payment: at the cinema box office before the show, or online with JazzCash, Easypaisa or card where the cinema supports it. Gift cards and loyalty points can pay part or all of a booking.
- Group bookings: the bill can be split into equal shares; each person pays their share by private link.
- Row pricing: front rows cheapest, centre "Prime Centre" rows have the best view, back rows are recliners. Premium formats (IMAX, Dolby Cinema, 4DX, ScreenX) cost more than standard 2D.
- Matinee: weekday shows before 5 PM are 15% cheaper automatically.
- Child tickets: ages 3-12, about 25% cheaper, not available on recliner rows.
- Snacks: popcorn, nachos, drinks and combos can be pre-ordered at checkout and collected at the counter.
- Loyalty: 5 points for every PKR 100 paid; 1 point = PKR 1 off a later booking.
- Cancellation: unpaid bookings can be cancelled online until 2 hours before the show; seats are released and coupons, gift card balance and points are returned.
- Sold out: customers can join a first-come waitlist and are notified (in-app, email or web push) when seats come back.
- E-tickets: every ticket has a signed QR code, can be added to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet, and stays available offline once opened.
- Reviews: only customers who booked a film can leave a "Verified booking" review, after the show has started.
- Languages: English and Urdu (right-to-left).
- Assistant: "Usher" on every page answers preset questions from live listings; it does not accept free text.
